title: Workforce Business Analyst
text: Workforce Business Analyst at Curran & Associates Pty Limited (Sydney, Parramatta & Western Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). The client is a NSW Government currently seeking an experienced BA to join the team. It is a newly created role to support their Performance function in identifying areas of improvement and changes through Reporting and Analysis. The role will be workforce-focused in understanding people performance and identifying areas of improvement. The successful candidate needs to have excellent data analysis skills, having working with people data and capable of creating dashboards on performance. This is perfect for those seeking a challenge where you have the opportunity to build something from scratch to support business improvements. Must Have: Strong Reporting skills Created Dashboards Workforce Analytics Stakeholder Management Advanced Excel skills
